txt: It feels flimsy in hand, with the words 'Revachol Zone of Control' written under a nondescript municipal logo. There's a picture of her with shorter hair inside, along with all her personal details.
She sighs and looks around. "I need to get it ready for the next lease, but as you can see, the previous tenant completely trashed the place."
"*Both* apartments are now unrentable. Both!" She's still shaking her head, manicured hands now crossed over the chest.
"A hole in the wall, can you believe it?" She spreads her hands. "And then the tenant ran off with his stuff. He's gone, the *money's* gone, just like that!" She snaps her fingers.
"And again, I have no idea how *stupid* mistakes like this can even happen, but Ron, when he came to close the door, didn't close the neighbouring door! And there's a hole in the wall!"
"But -- that was months ago. Anyway. Was there anything you wanted, or is that it? I'm in a hurry."
"Do you want to see my ID as well? You can't *legally* ask for it, but why not? Want to see my residence permit, too?" She fumbles through her purse, fishing out a light paper-clad passport.
"Don't ask me what happened with the wall, I have no idea how we're going to find the time or resources to fix it."
"Everyone says that real estate agents don't *do* anything, but here I am, in the middle of the night, cleaning up someone's 'crash pad'."
"Heh!" She smiles aggressively. "Sounds like you've spent too much time undercover in some rock band."
"I'll tell you, Martinaise has a future -- in a few years it's going to blossom with artists and creatives and those radiocomputer wizards."
"It *is*." She breathes in and out to the count of three -- it looks like some special stress release technique -- before she continues...
"It was some kind of a moribund old man, who used to be a business owner. You'd think they'd make rent..." She stops, hesitating.
"Of course," she replies with a smile, but her eyes remain glazed over -- she's been waiting for you to leave.
"Oh, that's another huge mess. The former tenant owes us three months of rent, *three*! We closed the apartment and planned on auctioning off the valuables, but..."

"Satisfied? My name is Marielle Charpentier and I'm an agent with Martinaise Realty Associates. I am *not* breaking in, as I have every *right* to be here. The keys, see?" She jingles a set of keys in her hand.
"So, the sooner we get this over with, the better." She means you -- time for the next question.
"Thank you." She slips the passport back in her purse. "Do you have any questions? I need to be back in midtown in an hour."
"These apartments are perfectly fine! They have gorgeous architecture, a million reál view of the bay, good ventilation, neighbours, life, spark... And they are affordable."
"Very well, but please make it quick." She slips the passport back to her purse and checks her watch. "I need to be back in La Delta in an hour."
"Well, it does *not* disappear from my hands, no, I don't let it."
"What now?" She crosses her arms impatiently.
